text:
Rina (CS): Quick heads-up: NewBridge just signaled they'll add two more squads next month (Search + Personalization). They mentioned session-scoped embeddings, realtime scoring, and heavy nightly ingest. Asking for ops checklist and quick sizing.
Cal (AM): Great expansion signal. Any rough qps estimates? helps decide Dedicated vs hosted.
Rina (CS): They sent roughs: Search ~480 rps peak, Personalization ~160 rps, nightly embed ~220k docs. Also multi-region concern (us-west + eu).
Jo (Eng): 480 rps + multi-region means recommend a Dedicated pilot with regional pools + KV cache. Suggest prefix caching, autoscale min 2 max 10, and warmup before cutover.
Pri (Solutions): Model plan: search uses a faster quantized embedder, personalization uses a higher-quality open model (rdx-4-ptq). Recommend canary 5-10% then ramp.
Rina (CS): Action items: 1) one-pager (config + month-1 cost delta) 2) onboarding playbook 3) canary checklist. @Cal you own pricing.
Cal (AM): On it 1 will include committed vs payg + regional egress notes and an upsell renewal angle.
Jo (Eng): Quick config snippet to share: 
```yaml
deployment: dedicated-regional
regions: [us-west, eu]
model_routes:
  - search_fast: rdx-embed-small-quant
  - personalization: rdx-4-ptq
batching: adaptive
kv_cache: prefix + session_id
autoscale: min:2, max:10
canary: split:10%, ramp:24h, checks: latency, 5xx, cost-delta
```
Pri (Solutions): I'll draft the traffic generator and an eval set for regressions. Will include embedding batching windows to avoid peak overlap.
alert-bot: ticket created "newbridge-regional-onboard" assigned to @Cal @Jo @Pri due_in: 4 business days.
Cal (AM): Renewal risk low; this looks like an upsell. Watch for cost sensitivity during pricing review.
Rina (CS): Agreed. Main risk: tail latency and multi-region egress. We'll include Optimize recommendations.
Jo (Eng): Technical note: recommend pre-warming KV cache 24-48h and run a synthetic canary to validate p95 before cutover.
Rina (CS): I'll schedule kickoff with their infra next Tue and share the one-pager before EOD tomorrow. Thanks team :rocket:
